# 1,000.00 USD bought at 1.40 into A, which owes 500.00.
#
# Imported into a book whose transfer out of A was imported before a balance
# past zero had a side of its own: A at −500.00 then opened no owed cost basis,
# so the 500.00 this repays has none to draw down, and the book gives this the
# 500.00 it brings in past zero. Brought forward through its export, the
# transfer opens A's owed cost basis, and this deposit, which repays it, is
# refused for giving no guid until it gives that cost basis's.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes, with the
# transfer put back as an earlier import left it.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.40 into A"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "1400.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1400.00 CAD
